// diagnostic

E2418

Error conversion cycle: `impl {Source} -> {Target}` would make conversion loop

What

Error conversion cycle: `impl {Source} -> {Target}` would make conversion loop

Why

Error conversions must form an acyclic route so a failure has one finite meaning.

Fix

remove this edge or choose a target that is not already reachable back to the source.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2418: tests/ui/e2418_error_conv_cycle.stderr.

Error [E2418]: error conversion cycle: `impl TargetErr -> SourceErr` would make conversion loop
  --> tests/ui/e2418_error_conv_cycle.jet:6:6
    |
  6 | impl TargetErr -> SourceErr { return SourceErr.One }
    |      ^^^^^^^^^
 Why: error conversions must form an acyclic route so a failure has one finite meaning.
 Fix: remove this edge or choose a target that is not already reachable back to the source.
